summary: Amphenol Corporation filed an 8-K announcing a two-for-one stock split via a stock dividend, approved by its board on August 5, 2026. Record date is August 17, 2026, with distribution on September 2, 2026. The company also declared a Q3 2026 dividend of $0.25 per pre-split share ($0.125 post-split), payable October 14, 2026. Post-split adjusted diluted EPS guidance for Q3 is $0.70–$0.71, versus pre-split $1.40–$1.42. This is a routine capital return action, not a special situation; no deal terms apply. Watch for any subsequent split-related adjustments or market reaction.
